labs.name: Delaware Public Health Laboratory (free state kits)
labs.detail: Not on ODW's approved list: DPHL is the state lab ("EPA State Primacy Water Laboratory") that tests the free private-well kits. Address and main phone are from the private-well sample forms (Rev 8/9/23) and DPH's contact page.
labs.note: DPH says test kits "for private drinking water are available for pickup and drop-off for testing at no charge," Monday-Friday 8:00 AM-4:30 PM, "for private well owners." Pick-up points on that page: University Office Plaza-Chopin Building, Suite 105, Newark; the Public Health Laboratory, Smyrna; James W. Williams Building, Suite 105 (302-744-1220); Stockley Center, Georgetown. (The 2023 forms and news release list Thomas Collins Building, Dover, and Thurman Adams State Service Center, Georgetown, instead, so call first.) Do not collect on Friday, Saturday or Sunday; run the cold water five minutes, fill from a bathroom sink or tub (not the kitchen), and return the sample to an EHFS office by 9:00 AM the day you collect it. Forms say bacteria results are mailed in 1-2 weeks and chemical results in 2-3 weeks, and are marked "PRIVATE HOMEOWNER USE ONLY - NOT FOR REAL ESTATE USE." Questions about results: DPH Health Systems Protection, 302-744-4830. DPHL does not test private wells for other contaminants unless ODW submits the sample.
labs.source_name: Delaware DPH: Private Drinking Water page ("last updated 4/24")
labs.source_name_2: DPH private well water sample forms (PDF, Rev 8/9/23)
